PostSummary: People share painful stories of being judged, controlled, shamed, or ignored by a church or its leaders. The videos resonate because the hurt is real, and many viewers recognize their own story in them.
BiblicalResponse: If this is your story, it matters, and it deserves to be heard — not minimized, not explained away. God does not defend the people who wounded you in His name; Jesus reserved His sharpest words for religious leaders who burdened others. Healing rarely comes from pretending it did not happen. It comes slowly, through honest lament, safe community, and a Christ who was Himself rejected by religious people and still welcomes you.
